    The data of gt_radmix(), and how other packages provide theirs

    gt_radmix_data.Rd

    gt_radmix() reads the data of x through gt_radmix_data(), a generic with a method for a tidypopgen::gen_tibble. Packages that store their data differently can provide methods for their own classes: this is how gt_radmix() fits genotype likelihoods, without tidygenclust depending on the packages that store them. Users do not need to call it.

    gt_radmix_data(x, use_imputed = FALSE, ...)

# Default S3 method
gt_radmix_data(x, use_imputed = FALSE, ...)

# S3 method for class 'gen_tbl'
gt_radmix_data(x, use_imputed = FALSE, ...)

    Arguments

    x

    the object given to gt_radmix()

    use_imputed

    boolean; whether imputed genotypes should be used, as in gt_radmix()

    ...

    further arguments for methods

    Value

    a list (see the details)

    Details

    A method for genotype likelihoods returns a list with the elements:

    • kind: "gl_source";

    • version: 1L, the version of the interface;

    • fill: an external pointer (made with R_MakeExternalPtrFn()) to a C function that fills the likelihoods of a block of individuals at one locus, tagged with the symbol tidygenclust_gl_fill;

    • ctx: an external pointer to the data that the function reads (its context);

    • n_indiv, n_loci: the numbers of individuals and loci, in the order of the rows of x and of tidypopgen::show_loci() (which label the rows of Q and of P);

    and any other element that must stay alive while gt_radmix() uses the source (e.g. the file-backed matrix that the context points into). The C function is specified in the header include/tidygenclust/radmix_gl_source.h of the installed package, which a package can copy (or use with LinkingTo: tidygenclust): it gives the likelihoods of 1 and 2 copies of allele2 relative to that of 0 copies, and whether each individual has data, and it is called from several threads, so it must not call R. The file src/radmix_gl_source.cpp of tidygenclust's sources is an example, used by its tests. P then gives the frequency of allele2. Cross-validation and starts from the SVD are not available for genotype likelihoods, and imputed values are meaningless for them, so a method should stop if use_imputed is TRUE.

    The list for a gen_tibble is internal to tidygenclust, and may change.

    See also

    gt_radmix(), whose details describe the model of genotype likelihoods
